map.租金/价款支付节奏、押金退还、违约责任与解除条件、知识产权与保密、争议管辖，是最: Rent/price payment rhythm, deposit refund, liability for breach and termination conditions, intellectual property and confidentiality, and dispute jurisdiction are the high-frequency clauses that most often trigger disputes and must be written clearly.

map.：应写明出借人/借款人、借款金额（大小写）、用途、年利率（不得超过 LPR 四倍: : it should state the lender/borrower, the amount (in words and figures), the purpose, the annual rate (must not exceed 4x the LPR), the interest payment method, liability for overdue payment, the court of jurisdiction and who bears the enforcement costs.
map.：应包含：月租金与支付方式（月付/季付/年付）、押金金额与退还条件、水电燃气物业: : it should include monthly rent and payment method (monthly/quarterly/annual), the deposit amount and refund conditions, who bears utilities and property fees, maintenance responsibility, early termination and breach of contract liability.
